assertions.name: sl2_q_schur_centralizer_identity
assertions.source: sl_2 q-Schur centralizer: [2]_q^n = Σ_{λ 2-row} dim_q(V_λ^{sl_2}) · dim(S^λ) where dim(S^λ) is the classical integer S_n-irrep dimension (H_n(q)-side of the centralizer carries classical dims). n=5: 1·[6]_q + 4·[4]_q + 5·[2]_q = [2]_q^5.

assertions.name: V_2_absent_from_sl2_at_n_equals_5
assertions.source: Classical SU(2) Clebsch-Gordan on V_{1/2}^⊗5 yields V_{5/2} ⊕ 4·V_{3/2} ⊕ 5·V_{1/2}; V_2 has multiplicity 0. The icosahedral H (dim 5) is NOT reachable via sl_2 q-Schur.

description: GAP-A-4 T8 — Reshetikhin-Turaev / q-Schur duality candidate functor.  Tests whether the icosahedral H-sector (3,2)+(2,2,1) corresponds to a single RT-quantum-dim-5 isotypic component (j=2 of SU(2) / a single sl_3 irrep).  Verdict: REFUTED at sl_2 (H absent from V_{1/2}^⊗5) and at sl_3 (H splits into two different irreps with HW (1,2) and (0,1)).

sl2_q_schur.verdict_sl2: Icosahedral H (dim 5) ABSENT from sl_2 q-Schur decomposition. (3,2) maps to j=1/2 (dim 2), NOT j=2 (dim 5).

sl3_q_schur.verdict_sl3: Icosahedral H splits into TWO different sl_3 irreps with highest weights (1,2) and (0,1) — NOT a single RT/q-Schur isotypic component.

su2_clebsch_gordan.verdict_classical: V_2 (dim 5) multiplicity = 0 in V_{1/2}^⊗5; Icosahedral H NOT reachable via SU(2) Schur-Weyl on 5 strands.

data.synthesis_verdict: RT / q-Schur duality candidate functor REFUTED at two ranks: (sl_2 m=2) V_2 multiplicity = 0 in V_{1/2}^⊗5 (Clebsch-Gordan verified V_{1/2}^⊗5 = V_{5/2} ⊕ 4V_{3/2} ⊕ 5V_{1/2}, total dim 32 = 2^5 ✓), so the dim-5 icosahedral H simply does NOT appear as a single sl_2 q-Schur isotypic component; (sl_3 m=3) both (3,2) and (2,2,1) are present but as TWO different sl_3 irreps with highest weights (1,2) and (0,1) — the icosahedral H = V_(3,2)+V_(2,2,1) is a sum of TWO DISTINCT sl_3 components, NOT a single 'spin j=2 / dim 5' RT-invariant. Both verdicts agree: the icosahedral H is fundamentally a NON-SCHUR-WEYL object — it lives at the LEVEL OF A_5 fiber action on V^⊗5, not in any standard q-Schur isotypic component. This is the 5th candidate functor REFUTED (after T5 F1/F2/F3, T7 Bratteli), and it is the **structurally most informative negative**: the icosahedral H simply DOES NOT FIT the standard q-Schur / RT framework, period.  The cross-algebra functor must live OUTSIDE the q-Schur picture — likely involving the icosahedral subgroup structure of SO(3) ⊂ PSL(2,ℂ) directly (Möbius / Bring / McKay E_8), not via a quantum group rep tower.
